title: The Smaily Connect plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in versions up to, and…
description: The Smaily Connect WordPress plugin versions up to and including 3.24.0 contains an Insecure Direct Object Reference vulnerability. Authenticated users with Subscriber-level access or higher can exploit this flaw to access other users' personal profile data by manipulating the user_id parameter in the URL. This vulnerability arises from insufficient authorization checks in the smaily_get_edit_user_id() function when rendering the WooCommerce My Account edit-account form.
